title: AMP Bank GO - Mobile Banking Reimagined
body:
O.P.
this post was edited
Hi,
There is an app for AMP for personal and business on the Apple AppStore and it says to use before February you need to contact AMP Bank to get a code, I called them but they didn’t have any idea about it?
Does anyone know if it can be opened before February?
AMP advised this was the link to register for the app. https://www.amp.com.au/c ampaigns/bank/sign-up-to-sign-off
More from the page:
Simply fill in your details to pre-register your interest in the new experience we’re building at AMP Bank. By doing so, you’ll automatically be entered into the draw to win a share of $50,000 worth of prizes including:
4 major cash prizes: Each worth $5,000! 300 monthly mini draws: 75 lucky winners every month will win one of 300 e-gift cards valued at $100 each.
All fields required
Competition closes on the 31 January 2025. While we encourage AMP employees and their families to sign up to hear more about the new banking experience, they are not eligible to enter the competition.

It is legit. It is the start of the rollout of the new platform. If you read the Mastercard removing numbers from physical cards thread, someone linked to AMP's press release on it. In that press release it also announced the release of its new digital-first bank in conjunction with the Mastercard initiative:
https://corporate.amp.com.au /newsroom/2025/january/amp-b ank-partners-with-mastercard -to-deliver-australia-s-first-n
AMP Bank’s partnership with Mastercard marks a significant milestone as it approaches the launch of its new digital-first bank.
The new bank will use Engine by Starling...enabled Starling Bank to become the first profitable digital bank in the UK
Like Starling Bank, the new AMP banking app has been designed so...
Last year, they had asked customers to fill out a form if they had interest in taking part in trying out the new platform: /thread/91mxk2q6?p=42#r824
This is the UK bank that AMP had acquired the new platform from: https://www.starlingbank.com/

Quite surprisingly, it's very easy to bypass the AMP early access code on their app to setup an account on their so called "reimagined" banking app. You can proceed to complete all steps to the end where you need to take a video of yourself signing up for the app before submission.
You need to mention your name in the short video.
Similar to how ANZ Plus does their signup.
It then sits in review where it says, "current average review time 3 days".
I am surprised they don't have any sort of security protocol that would prevent a bypass of the early access code. Makes it pointless to have it. **

Yep. I think they are yet to actually release it, I was advised February 10.
You could actually bypass the early access code by downloading the app & not opening it, then putting your device into flight mode, progressing forward with the first two steps, it would then say you are offline, put yourself back into data mode & progress to signup.
AMP is asking me about this but I am only actioning this based on what I went through. So who knows, but it appears yes its open now for signup and for review by February 10.
Could even happen before that as the app says 3 hours average review time. Shrug, AMP, expect the unexpected.
